# A2V2.ai

> A2V2.ai is an AI-powered engagement platform that creates personalized AI clones replicating a professional's communication style for automated client and patient engagement. The platform serves two core verticals: healthcare (HIPAA-compliant patient engagement for longevity and preventive medicine practices) and real estate (AI-powered client engagement for real estate agents).

## Core Product

A2V2.ai builds AI clones — intelligent agents trained on a professional's communication patterns, tone, and domain expertise. These clones handle real-time engagement across text, chat, and voice, operating 24/7 to ensure no lead, patient, or client inquiry goes unanswered.

### Healthcare Vertical

HIPAA-compliant AI patient engagement built for longevity medicine, hormone replacement therapy (HRT), functional medicine, and preventive health practices. Capabilities include:

- Automated patient follow-up and protocol adherence tracking
- Appointment scheduling and no-show recovery
- Lead conversion from website visitors to booked consultations
- Lab follow-up reminders and supplement coordination
- Lapsed patient re-engagement sequences
- Wearable data integration (Oura Ring, Whoop, CGMs, Apple Health, Fitbit, Garmin)
- EHR and practice management system integration

### Real Estate Vertical

AI-powered client engagement for real estate professionals. Capabilities include:

- Automated lead nurturing and qualification
- Property inquiry responses with listing-specific context
- Client follow-up sequences across the buying and selling lifecycle
- Appointment and showing scheduling
- Multi-channel communication (text, email, chat)

## Key Differentiators

- **HIPAA Compliance**: Full HIPAA-compliant infrastructure for healthcare including signed BAA, 256-bit AES encryption, role-based access controls, and complete audit logging
- **AI Clone Technology**: Custom AI agents that replicate a professional's specific communication style, not generic chatbots
- **Custom Engineering**: Tailored integrations and workflows built for each practice or business
- **Enterprise Integration**: Designed to connect with existing EHR systems, CRMs, scheduling tools, and communication platforms
- **Multi-Industry Flexibility**: Single platform architecture serving healthcare and real estate with industry-specific compliance and workflow requirements

## Pricing

- **Starter** ($297/month): 1 AI clone, 1,000 contacts, basic integrations, email and chat support
- **Professional** ($497/month): 2 AI clones, 5,000 contacts, advanced integrations, priority support, analytics dashboard
- **Business** ($997/month): 5 AI clones, 25,000 contacts, custom integrations, dedicated account manager, advanced analytics
- **Enterprise** (Custom pricing): Unlimited AI clones, unlimited contacts, custom engineering, SLA, dedicated support team, full API access
